```xml
<robot name="cabinet_2_door">
  <!-- Dimensions (meters) -->
  <!-- Width: 1.01, Height: 1.84, Depth: 0.30 -->
  <!-- Origin: on the floor under the middle of the object -->
  <!-- X: across width, Y: toward the back (front faces -Y), Z: up -->

  <link name="base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.16" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="40"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.9" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="5.5" iyz="0" izz="6.4"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.16" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.30 0.32"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.16" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.30 0.32"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Left door -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <inertial>
      <!-- approximate door mass distribution -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.21" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="1.08" iyz="0" izz="1.08"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.005 -0.105 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.505 0.01 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.005 -0.105 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.505 0.01 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Right door -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.21" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="1.08" iyz="0" izz="1.08"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.005 -0.105 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.505 0.01 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.005 -0.105 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.505 0.01 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Cabinet back panel (for contact/structure mass) -->
  <link name="back_panel">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="10"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.6" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="1.8" iyz="0" izz="1.8"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.01 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.15 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.01 0.01 1.84"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joints -->
  <!-- Hinges rotate about vertical axis (Z) for outward swinging:
       Left door rotates +Z (counterclockwise as seen from +Z) outward.
       Right door rotates +Z similarly. -->
  <joint name="hinge_left" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <!-- Hinge line at middle vertical edge between doors: x=+0.505/2 = +0.2525? but total width 1.01 -->
    <!-- Midplane at x=0. Left door spans x in [-0.505/2, 0] => hinge at x=0 -->
    <origin xyz="0 -0.15 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.5708" upper="1.5708" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="2.0" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="hinge_right" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <!-- Hinge at x=0 (same middle line) -->
    <!-- But right door geometry is offset so it occupies x in [0, +0.505] -->
    <origin xyz="0 -0.15 0.92" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.5708" upper="1.5708" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="2.0" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Materials -->
  <material name="wood">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.42 0.30 1"/>
  </material>
</robot>
```
